class IncludeTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self._tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.dir = self._tmp.name
        self.addCleanup(self._tmp.cleanup)

    def write(self, name, text):
        path = os.path.join(self.dir, name)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            fh.write(text)
        return path

    def test_inline_and_override_order(self):
        self.write("inc.conf", "a = inc\nb = inc\n")
        main = self.write("main.conf", "a = before\n@include inc.conf\nb = after\n")
        cfg = load(main)
        self.assertEqual(cfg.get("a"), "inc")
        self.assertEqual(cfg.get("b"), "after")

    def test_relative_to_including_file_and_nested(self):
        self.write("sub/leaf.conf", "leaf = 1\n")
        self.write("sub/mid.conf", "@include leaf.conf\nmid = 2\n")
        main = self.write("main.conf", "@include sub/mid.conf\n")
        cfg = load(main)
        self.assertEqual(cfg.get("leaf"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(cfg.get("mid"), 2)

    def test_missing(self):
        main = self.write("main.conf", "@include nope.conf\n")
        with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
            load(main)

    def test_cycles(self):
        self_inc = self.write("self.conf", "@include self.conf\n")
        with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
            load(self_inc)
        self.write("a.conf", "@include sub/b.conf\n")
        self.write("sub/b.conf", "@include ../a.conf\n")
        with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
            load(os.path.join(self.dir, "a.conf"))

    def test_repeated_include_is_not_a_cycle(self):
        self.write("c.conf", "k = 1\n")
        main = self.write("main.conf", "@include c.conf\n@include c.conf\n")
        self.assertEqual(load(main).get("k"), 1)


if __name__
